protocol_metadata.about: infiniFi is an Ethereum-based yield protocol that allows users to deposit stablecoins (primarily USDC) to mint iUSD, a receipt token. Users choose between staking iUSD (liquid, withdrawable at any time) or locking it for 1–13 weeks for higher yields represented by liUSD-xw locked-position tokens. The protocol allocates pooled capital across a mix of liquid on-chain DeFi strategies (Aave, Morpho, Pendle, Ethena) and higher-yielding illiquid strategies, applying an on-chain fractional reserve model to deliver amplified yields without leverage. Governance uses weighted voting by locked-token holders to determine farm allocation, with two timelocks (short and long) protecting protocol-parameter changes.
